info.title: API.SH: TradingView
info.description: The TradingView API from API.SH: public TradingView data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Stocks with an ex-dividend (or payment) date in a date range: ex-date, payment date, amount, yield, frequency, price and market cap, largest companies first. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-dividends-calendar

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (default 7 days after from; up to 92 days).

parameters.name: date_type
parameters.description: Which date falls in the range.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Stock market (america, uk, india, germany, japan...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Companies reporting earnings in a date range (up to 31 days; default the next 7 days) for a stock market: symbol, company, report date and time (before open or after close), status (reported or upcoming), fiscal period, EPS estimate and actual with the surprise (value and %), revenue estimate and actual with the surprise, market cap, price, sector and industry. Filter by exchange or minimum market cap; sort by market cap or date. Reported figures are available for the latest quarter only. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-earnings-calendar

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days after `from`; at most 31 days).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Stock market (default america), e.g. america, uk, india, germany, japan, canada, australia.

parameters.name: min_market_cap
parameters.description: Minimum market cap in the listing currency.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Economic events from TradingView's economic calendar for a date range (up to 92 days; default the next 7 days): date and time, country, currency, title, indicator, category, period, importance (low, medium, high), actual, forecast and previous values (scaled and raw, with unit and scale), TradingView ticker of the indicator, source and description. Filter by countries, importance, category or a text search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-economic-calendar

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated two-letter country codes, e.g. `US,EU,GB,JP,CN,DE` (EU = euro area).

parameters.name: importance
parameters.description: Comma-separated importance levels: low, medium, high.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category code, e.g. lbr (labour), inf (prices), gdp, mny (money), cnsm (consumer), bsnss (business), hse (housing), gov, trd (trade).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only events whose title contains this text, e.g. `CPI`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Fiscal-period financials of a listed company, annual or quarterly, newest period first: income statement (revenue, gross profit, operating income, EBITDA, net income, EPS basic and diluted, R&D), balance sheet (assets, current assets, cash, goodwill, liabilities, debt, net debt, equity) and cash flow (operating, investing, financing, free cash flow, capital expenditures), plus key ratios (margins, ROE, ROA, ROIC, current and quick ratio, debt to equity). Revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, net income, EPS, total assets, total debt and free cash flow carry up to 20 annual or 32 quarterly periods; the other lines and the ratios cover the latest period. Stocks only: funds, indices, crypto and forex have no statements.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-financials

parameters.name: periods
parameters.description: How many periods to return (default 8, max 32).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: TradingView hotlists (top gainers, losers, most active)
get.description:
Stock hotlists for a market or exchange, ranked like TradingView's own: top gainers, top losers, most active (volume), most traded (value), most volatile, unusual volume, gap up / gap down, at 52-week high / low, largest by market cap. Each stock: rank, symbol, ticker, name, link, logo, exchange, currency, price, change and change %, gap %, volume, relative volume, value traded, market cap, P/E, sector, industry, daily volatility, 52-week high and low, pre- and post-market change. Filters: exchange, minimum price, volume and market cap. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-hotlists

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Stock market (default america), e.g. america, uk, india, germany, japan, canada, australia, brazil, hongkong.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Comments on a published TradingView trade idea, newest first or top-rated first: comment id, text, date, likes, reply count, posting platform and author (id, username, profile link, plan, badges). 20 comments a page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-idea-comments

parameters.name: idea
parameters.description: The idea's 8-character id (the part before the title in its link, e.g. `pCdqvTF2`), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Page cursor. Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Community trade ideas on TradingView, for a symbol or across the site: title, description, chart link and image, symbol, author, publish time, likes, comments, views and flags (video, education, editors' pick, hot). Sort by recent, trending or popular. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-ideas

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: EXCHANGE:TICKER (leave out for ideas on every symbol).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recent (default), trending, week_popular, latest_popular or picked_time (editors' picks).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
TradingView's screener for a market: rows of any columns the screener knows, filtered and sorted. Defaults per market type: stocks (price, change, volume, relative volume, market cap, P/E, EPS, dividend yield, sector, industry, performance, rating), crypto and forex. Shortcut filters (exchange, sector, industry, type, market cap, price, volume, change, P/E) and a raw `filter` for anything else. `total` is the number of matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-screener

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market: `america` (default), `uk`, `india`, `germany`, `canada`, `japan`, `hongkong`, `australia`, `brazil`, any other country name the screener uses, or `crypto` (pairs), `coin` (coins), `forex`, `futures`, `bond`, `cfd`.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated columns, e.g. `name,close,change,volume,market_cap_basic,price_earnings_ttm,RSI,Perf.Y` (up to 80; unknown columns come back null).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by (default market_cap_basic; crypto: 24h_vol|5; coin: market_cap_calc; forex: name).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Extra conditions as a JSON array of {left, operation, right}, e.g. `[{"left":"RSI","operation":"less","right":30}]`. Operations: greater, egreater, less, eless, equal, nequal, in_range, not_in_range, match, crosses, crosses_above, crosses_below, above%, below%, has, has_none_of, empty, nempty.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One symbol on TradingView (stock, ETF, crypto pair, currency, index, future): name, type, exchange, currency, country, sector, industry, ISIN/CUSIP/CIK; price, open, high, low, change, volume and average volume, pre- and post-market price; market cap, enterprise value, P/E, EPS, dividend yield, P/B, P/S, revenue, net income, margins, ROE, debt/equity, employees, beta, share counts, next and last earnings dates; 52-week and all-time high/low, performance (1 w to 5 y), volatility and the overall technical rating. Fields that do not apply to the asset type are null. Also returns `analyst` (average, median, high and low price target; strong buy, buy, hold, sell and strong sell counts; consensus rating; EPS and revenue forecasts for this and next fiscal quarter), `dividends` (yield, payout ratio, dividend per share for the fiscal year and quarter with growth, the last and upcoming dividend with amount, ex-date and payment date, years of continuous payouts and growth) and `financials` (total assets, total debt, cash and short-term investments, free cash flow, EBITDA, return on assets, current and quick ratio, price to free cash flow, EV/EBITDA); each is null when it does not apply. `fields` adds any other screener columns under `fields`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-symbol

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol as EXCHANGE:TICKER, e.g. `NASDAQ:AAPL`, `NYSE:BRK.B`, `NSE:RELIANCE`, `BINANCE:BTCUSDT`, `FX:EURUSD`, `TVC:GOLD` (find it with /tradingview/v1/search).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Extra columns to return under `fields`, comma-separated screener column names (up to 50), e.g. `Perf.10Y,EMA50,RSI|60,price_target_1y`. Unknown columns come back as null.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
TradingView's technical ratings for a symbol and timeframe: the summary rating (-1 to 1, label strong_sell to strong_buy) with buy/sell/neutral counts, the oscillators (RSI, Stochastic, CCI, ADX, Awesome Oscillator, Momentum, MACD, Stochastic RSI, Williams %R, Bull Bear Power, Ultimate Oscillator) and moving averages (EMA/SMA 10-200, Ichimoku base line, VWMA, Hull MA) each with value and action, and pivot points (classic, Fibonacci, Camarilla, Woodie, DeMark).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-technicals

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol as EXCHANGE:TICKER, e.g. `NASDAQ:AAPL`, `NYSE:BRK.B`, `NSE:RELIANCE`, `BINANCE:BTCUSDT`, `FX:EURUSD`, `TVC:GOLD` (find it with /tradingview/v1/search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A TradingView user's public profile: username, status and signature, join date, last visit, followers, following, number of published ideas and scripts, plan, broker flag, badges, avatar and linked website, X (Twitter), YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, plus their published ideas, newest first (title, description, link, chart image, symbol, date, likes, comments, views, video/education/script flags). Pass `next_page` back as `page` for older ideas; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tradingview-user

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the user's ideas. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
